brief:
OUTLET: Mondoweiss reported on Ali Abu Khdeir's family abandoning their house in Deir Jarir, where his grandfather had lived for three generations. Israeli settlers' threats of violence made remaining in the residence untenable, forcing the family to leave property they had occupied for decades.

The departure has heightened fears among other residents of Deir Jarir, who worry they may face similar pressure to abandon their homes. The case reflects an escalating pattern of settler activity targeting Palestinian communities in the West Bank.
dek: For three generations, Ali Abu Khdeir's family lived in the home his grandfather built in Deir Jarir until Israeli settlers made staying too dangerous. Now residents fear that their families are next.
title: Palestinian family flees ancestral home after settler threats
